points.name: apps.weather.alert.row_register
points.interpretation: The row builder registers callback 0x0c60962d for filter 7, passing the row index as user data.

points.name: apps.weather.alert.row_event_code
points.interpretation: The row callback reads the event code, and only code 7 navigates to alert detail with its user data.

points.name: apps.weather.alert.row_icon
points.interpretation: The row builder sets alert_big_icon.bin for each constructed alert row.

points.name: apps.weather.alert.row_caption
points.interpretation: The row builder sets the localized alert.weather caption.

points.name: apps.weather.alert.row_time
points.interpretation: The row builder displays a formatted time buffer for each row.

points.name: apps.weather.alert_detail.caption
points.interpretation: The detail page displays the localized alert.weather caption.

points.name: apps.weather.alert_detail.body
points.interpretation: The detail page displays the alert body from the indexed weather data record.

evidence: The weather manifest registers both descriptors. The page manager owns each descriptor root slot. The list create callback calls the row builder for each alert; the builder registers a row callback with event filter 7 and index user data. The callback checks the event code and passes the index to navigation page 0x00210004. The detail page indexes weather records and displays the body.
scope: Only the recorded list row and detail display calls while the respective descriptor root is present. Other weather alert data ingestion, background notifications and detail navigation paths are not covered.
limitations: The row builder call sites are shared by rows. Altering event user data can send an invalid index to the detail page. Page root checks are not thread barriers; shared-entry publication and rollback require system-wide quiescence. Device behavior remains unverified.
